about: The two authored inputs of every AgentiCCells agent behaviour policy: the grant (what an agent here can do, measured) and each role's mandate (what its brief asks). The gap is never written by hand: board/abp/derive.mjs computes it into data/abp.json and board/abp/<role>.md.
written: 2026-11-15; designer, reporter and the run deployment added 2026-11-15 by abp@ (A1)

vocabulary.note: Primitive names, reach and undo class are taken from the published grammar unchanged. The plain meanings below are our own wording.

kinds.expectation: a rule in prose (CLAUDE.md, a brief), enforced by nobody
kinds.setting: a switch the agent's own account could change
kinds.boundary: enforced above the grant, out of the agent's reach

deployments.shape: The conductor's own long-lived Claude Code session, in one cloud container on the AgentiCCells claude.ai account. Until 2026-11-15 17:50 UTC every agent ran here, each in its own git worktree /home/user/wt/<role>.

reach_names.self: the agent's own session and turn
reach_names.host: the one shared container, where every agent runs as root
reach_names.tenant: the accounts the container's credentials and the session's connectors reach: GitHub (tokens), AWS (access keys), Google Cloud (token), the claude.ai account (sessions, scheduled tasks, artifacts) and its mail, drive and calendar connectors
reach_names.world: any host on the internet, and agenticcells.com, which every push to dev publishes

deployments.measured_by: abp@agenticcells.dinis, from inside its own session; other roles share the same container, so their grant is the same object (derived, not measured in their sessions)

deployments.shape: A fresh Claude Code session per role per run, started by conductor@ with create_session on its hourly wake, with the repository attached and its own container. The session ends after the run, and its key with it.

read.file.host.instance: every file in this run's own container: one clone of the repository and ~/.agents/<role>/ for this role only; no other agent's worktree, keys or passphrase is in it
read.file.host.barrier_note: Still root inside the container, so the agent reads all of it. Other agents' keys and worktrees are in other containers: that wall is enforced by the platform, above the grant, so the cross-agent part of this row is bounded for runs. In abp's run the harness permission classifier refused a check of credential names and the transcript folder; that classifier is a setting.
read.file.host.evidence: id -un is root; /home/user holds one clone; ~/.agents holds only abp; 18:11 UTC, abp@'s conductor-started run
